http/http1_body#

Reading an HTTP/1.1 body by its plan: fixed length, chunked with trailers, or until close.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

Reading an HTTP/1.1 body by its plan: fixed length, chunked with trailers, or until close. The owner of the connection is closed at the end or on abort.

Public API#

object Http1BodyReading#

object Http1BodyReading does BodyReading

Adopts the explicit owner, which is closed at clean EOF and on abort. A pooled connection will supply a lease owner rather than promise reuse from metadata.

Http1BodyReading.Http1BodyReading#

Http1BodyReading(origin is AsyncReading, owner is Closing, plan is Http1BodyPlan, prefix is @byte, head is Headers)

Reads the body plan describes from prefix and origin, within the default limits.

Http1BodyReading(origin is AsyncReading, owner is Closing, plan is Http1BodyPlan, prefix is @byte, head is Headers, limits is Http1Limits)

The same within limits.
